q1fy27.capexApproved: Rs203 cr approved in Q1FY27 (Rs196 cr for capacity expansion at Unit 1); Rs1,460 cr approved over the last 13 quarters, Rs870 cr spent, balance committed to projects under way
commentary: Total income Rs650.1 cr (+116% YoY; revenue from operations Rs641.5 cr, +119%); commercial CMS projects were 'the primary drivers of growth' (CFO).
EBITDA (company, incl. other income) Rs231.1 cr, margin 35.5% (14.0% in Q1FY26, 40.5% in Q4FY26); gross margin 61.2% vs 55.3% 'a function of our business mix'.
PAT Rs147.4 cr (Rs13.7 cr in Q1FY26); EPS Rs114.9.
Working capital fell from 137 days of sales (Mar-26) to 84 days, mainly lower receivables; net cash rose to Rs308.5 cr from Rs156.8 cr.
Capex outflow Rs121.6 cr, 'primarily driven by new R&D and peptide facilities'; Rs203 cr of new projects approved (Rs196 cr for Unit 1).
CMS commercial revenue Rs418 cr and development Rs20 cr; 'about 3' commercial molecules 'really drive our business'; one more commercialisation expected in FY27 and one or two in FY28 (CEO).
GDS: Ezetimibe, Mirtazapine, Escitalopram and Aripiprazole were key contributors; strategic collaboration with Gland Pharma for sterile APIs (asset-light).
Peptide plant (Module 1) to be commissioned the following month; projects lined up; a new building at an FDA-approved site, so an FDA inspection will follow but is not seen as gating.
No formal guidance: 'we've always aspired to grow at about 20%, and we expect that FY27 & FY28 also we expect to grow that way'; margin 'go back to the 25%'; ROCE may dip as capex rises.
q1fy27.src: q1ppt pp.6-11, 29-30; q1call pp.2-14; Screener quarterly

guidance.growth: No formal guidance; ~20% growth aspiration for FY27 and FY28 (q1call); 18-20% CAGR 'not necessarily linearly', over a five-year view and 'aspirational' (q4call)
guidance.margin: '25% plus is what we would be coming for. And anything that's above that is kind of a bonus'; FY26 helped by favourable exchange rates (q1call, q4call)
guidance.returns: ROCE expected to moderate as longer capital deployment cycles begin (q4call, q1call)
guidance.lumpiness: Q4FY26 was 'more of a Q3 plus Q4 kind of a performance'; judge the business over 10-12 quarters (q4call, q1call)
guidance.crisil: CRISIL expects FY27 revenue growth above 15%; peptide revenue from FY28, meaningful over ~3 years (crisil, 25-Aug-2026)
history: FY25 call cycle: management said FY25 would be a flattish year after FY24; revenue fell 5% (q1call recollection).

Q4FY26 call (12-May-2026): FY26 'strong growth when viewed against FY24' delivered (revenue +37%), helped by the rupee; 18-20% CAGR remains the aspiration; utilisation 85-90% at the units and ~65% at the last unit.
Q1FY27 call (5-Aug-2026): Q1 'broadly in line'; FY27 and FY28 expected to grow ~20%; one commercialisation in FY27; capex intensity to rise further, possibly overseas or via M&A for new modalities.

cms.projects: 99 active projects at Jun-2026: 17 pre-clinical, 23 phase 1, 20 phase 2, 13 phase 3, 7 pre-registration/registered, 19 commercial (98 at Mar-26; 87 at Q4FY23); 4 NDAs approved, 27 INDs supported
cms.concentration: FY26: CMS top 5 customers 93% and top 5 products 94% of CMS revenue; Q1FY27 96% and 96%. Company-wide top 5 customers 64% (FY26) and 70% (Q1FY27); three customer groups were 54% of FY26 revenue
cms.molecules: The company does not name CMS molecules (confidentiality). Brokers and press link its commercial CMS supplies to xanomeline (BMS's Cobenfy, approved by the USFDA in Sep-2024), bempedoic acid (Esperion / Daiichi Sankyo) and deutetrabenazine (Teva) (B&K, 14-Oct-2024); an analyst on the Q4FY26 call named Esperion's bempedoic acid as a big customer product (Esperion received a takeover bid from ArchiMed on 1-May-2026); management neither confirmed nor denied
cms.peptides: 8-10 peptide programmes in development (some advanced); a peptide collaboration announced with LIR Life Sciences is early-stage; peptide CDMO market USD5-6 bn per consultants (q4call)
